name: Zawy
cooked: I said the 7200 couldn’t cheat enough to get unlimited blocks because 7200 / 2016 / 600 is too small at only 0.6%. From the T(w,U) equation it looks like a lower w and higher U can result in a negative T which means unlimited blocks in finite time. I may have mentioned this two years ago, but it was dismissed as not something the chain was going to exhibit anytime soon.
